array.string: MARK="$HOME/Library/Application Support/Despierto/activo" alive() { PID=$(/bin/cat "$MARK" 2>/dev/null) [ -n "$PID" ] || return 1 /bin/ps -ww -p "$PID" -o args= 2>/dev/null | /usr/bin/grep -q 'despierto-timer' } [ -r "$MARK" ] || exit 0 alive && exit 0 /bin/sleep 3 [ -r "$MARK" ] || exit 0 alive && exit 0 if /usr/bin/pmset -g | /usr/bin/grep -q 'SleepDisabled[[:space:]]*1'; then /usr/bin/sudo -n /usr/bin/pmset -a disablesleep 0 || exit 1 fi /bin/rm -f "$MARK"
